candidates.requirement: Compute the compressed buffer allocation size without signed integer overflow for a library-supported input size.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls FUZZ_seed, then state_create, which evaluates 1024 + 2 * LZ4_compressBound(size) before allocating the compressed buffer.
candidates.failure_condition: With 1,073,741,824 bytes remaining after seed consumption, LZ4_compressBound returns 1,077,952,592. Multiplication by 2 exceeds INT_MAX in int arithmetic, causing undefined behavior before allocation.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry calls state_create unconditionally; no size guard precedes the expression.
